versions.subject: New Linux Auditd Rules - Steghide Steganography
versions.detection:
type: 
    type: EXECVE
commands:
    a0: steghide
    a1: extract
a2:
    a2: '-sf'
a3:
    a3|endswith:
      - '.jpg'
      - '.png'
condition: type and commands and a2 and a3
versions.spl: type="EXECVE" a0="steghide" a1="extract" a2="-sf" a3 IN ("*.jpg", "*.png")
